summary: U.S. Physical Therapy, Inc. filed a Form 8-K reporting Q2 2026 financial results and a declared quarterly dividend of $0.46 per share payable September 11, 2026. The filing includes a press release and reaffirms full-year guidance. No transaction, strategic review, or activist activity is disclosed. This is a routine earnings and dividend announcement, not a special situation. The interim CFO signed the report, but no management change event is described.
